name: Jump Up and Get Down
author: Manticor
bootlegger: Every player other than the demon starts as an outsider. The librarian and pit hag cannot start in play.
The Fang Gu limit no longer exists. Every outsider killed by the Fang Gu is jumped to.

If at least one good player voted for the nomination, and that player is “about to die”, then the execution happens as normal. If only evil players vote for a nomination, the vote tally for that nominee is zero. If the politican is the only good player that votes, they count as evil for that vote.
